description: This script is an automation wrapper for starting and monitoring the otbr-agent process, handling device and interface readiness checks, and cleaning up stale processes.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages with a specific prefix for easier identification.

methods.name: wait_for_device
methods.description: Waits for the device at the specified path to appear, retries up to a limit.

methods.name: wait_for_interface
methods.description: Waits for the specified network interface to become available.

methods.name: kill_stale_processes
methods.description: Terminates any existing ot-daemon or otbr-agent processes to avoid conflicts.
